metadata.title: feat: REST API data population framework
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Adds a complete REST API data population framework (`tests/populate/`) that generates realistic test data by calling actual gateway HTTP endpoints, exercising the full write path including validation, auth middleware, RBAC, and side effects
- 10 entity populators (users, teams, RBAC roles, gateways, tools, resources, prompts, servers, A2A agents, tokens) with dependency ordering and async batch execution
- 3 scale profiles: small (~5K entities, ~1 min), medium (~300K, ~30 min), large (~13M, hours)
- Includes verify and cleanup utilities, Makefile targets, and rich progress display
- Fixes locustfile A2A agent handling: adds feature flag, nested body format, pre-fetched IDs

## Test plan
- [x] `python -m tests.populate --profile small` against fresh gateway: 5,567 created, 6 errors (gateway URL validation only)
- [x] `python -m tests.populate.verify` confirms all entity counts: ALL CHECKS PASSED
- [x] `python -m tests.populate.cleanup --confirm` deletes all MCP entities with 0 errors
- [x] Dry-run mode (`--dry-run`) previews without making requests
- [x] Custom `--base-url` flag and `MCPGATEWAY_BASE_URL` env var work correctly

Closes #2759

commits.message:
feat: add REST API data population framework (tests/populate)

Adds a complete data population framework that generates realistic test
data by calling actual gateway HTTP endpoints, exercising the full write
path including validation, auth middleware, RBAC, and side effects.

- 10 entity populators: users, teams, RBAC, gateways, tools, resources,
  prompts, servers, A2A agents, tokens
- 3 scale profiles: small (~5K), medium (~300K), large (~13M entities)
- Async HTTP client with retry, rate-limit handling, and concurrency
- Rich progress tracking with live table display
- Verify and cleanup utilities
- Makefile targets: populate-small, populate-verify, populate-clean
- Locustfile A2A fixes: feature flag, nested body format, proper IDs

Closes #2759

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix: suppress log noise and stabilize Rich Live display

- Default log level to WARNING; suppress httpx/httpcore/mcpgateway loggers
- Replace Layout with Group to avoid height recalculation jumpiness
- Pad log panel to fixed height so content doesn't shift
- Reduce refresh rate from 10 to 4 fps

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
perf: increase default concurrency and fix semaphore usage

- Bump small profile: 25 -> 100 concurrent, medium: 50 -> 200, large: 100 -> 300
- Release semaphore during retry backoff sleep instead of holding it
- Document concurrency knobs in small.yaml for easy tuning

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
